answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn; spawning a new identity needs an already-bonded peer to vouch and co-stake, and that voucher is slashed if the newcomer cheats. An honest garden of agents stays cheap, but an attacker cloning a whole grove of sybils must fund a fresh ferrous-hard bond for each fake and risk burning the voucher capital on every caught fraud. Cost rises linearly per identity, so large sybil swarms stop being profitable.
